cases.detail: Disposable Owner signs in using the original FIDUNIO API and demo Auth/Firestore
Owner sends four actual invitations; recipients consume them; Auth accounts and Firestore profiles created
Used/revoked invitation rejected; User cannot issue/list invites; Admin can issue and Owner revokes
Original direct-conversation API creates shared record; outsider read denied by real rules
Direct encrypted-envelope transport, disappearing metadata, sent→delivered→read, emoji add/remove/invalid
Block denies direct transport in actual Firestore rules; unblock removes restriction
Original group creation writes owner, two members and membership metadata; outsider denied
Only group admin can rename; owner cannot be removed
Encrypted group transport, member-only access, disappearing metadata, delivery/read receipts, emoji toggle
Web notification device registration, sender privacy preference, cross-user isolation, deletion; ADM direct write denied (lease API only)
Report abuse creates open report; authorized system Admin can view it
System Admin suspends/restores user; suspended user cannot write group
